notes: UI consistency release - every manage screen now uses full-height 48dp fields and matched buttons; inventory tabs keep their drafts when switching and auto-scroll to the active tab; stock adjust shows a live new-balance preview; receive lines get qty steppers and duplicate-merge; count/batches/thresholds/movements gain search and filters; expenses, staff and customers lists are proper cards - customers are now editable by tap; category icons are picked visually and actually apply on the POS rail; sync shows an online/standalone badge and blocks concurrent syncs; all headers get a circular back button; order/kitchen actions reach touch size.
